notes.title: Patch v1.0.6
notes.content:
[b]Bugs fixed:[/b]
- Fixed bug with teleport using grill press
- Fixed a bug with a negative value of the current expiration date and temperature for the food holder
- Fixed a bug where the visualization of products added to the food holder did not appear
- Fixed bug of changing the number of products in the food holder after saving / loading

[b]Changes in mechanics:[/b]
- Changed card cost calculations for playing Blackjack. Now Jack, Queen and King have a face value of 10, instead of 2, 3, 4 respectively

notes.title: Patch v1.0.5 Big Update
notes.content:
[b]New mechanics:[/b]
- Added new timing system
- Added a new object management system
- Added a system for optimizing objects on the game scene
- Added information about the item in the store: icon, price, description
- Added calculation of the maximum possible amount of goods when buying
- Added order list of each individual customer
- Added new mechanics of transferring items to the merchant, both individually and all at once
- Added dirt on tables from visitors
- Traders at the start of each day collect $40 of their previous business day's fee
- Added the ability to get an achievement from an early status, but for this you need to be careful and enter the correct combination
- Added several combinations with different effects


[b]Changes in mechanics:[/b]
- Removed air temperature
- Removed the binding of food spoilage rate to the current temperature in the game
- Increased in-game day time from 15 minutes to 20
- Increased the waiting time for orders by units
- Removed items dropping from hands when trying to put them in a full fridge
- Inventory expanded to 20 slots
- Added notification that the refrigerator is full
- The system for choosing the quantity of goods when buying has been redesigned
- Sausages no longer have a burnt status
- Hot dog buns, ready kebab, cutlets no longer disappear when burned, but remain a burnt object that can be used
- The user will be dissatisfied with the quality of service if you give him burnt food
- Daily profit now shows the daily income of both the employee and yours at the current point
- Now hired employees automatically open their outlet
- Now the user pays for the received goods even if the outlet was closed or the waiting time expired
- You can now name your game save
- Completely redesigned tutorial system


[b]Bugs fixed:[/b]
- Fixed bug with negative timing of clients on chairs
- Fixed a bug where a chair would save all modifiers for a given point when it was moved
- Fixed bug with shelves. Clients will bypass them
- Fixed a bug with buying certificates ahead of time
- Fixed a bug where weekly payments were not made after 91 days
- Fixed a bug with the ability to set prices for goods that do not have a certificate
- Fixed a bug with the ability to sell goods for which there is no certificate
- Fixed a bug where the outlet did not change its name
- Fixed a bug where spoiled kebab meat was not removed
- Fixed bug with french fries basket when interacting with fries storage
- Fixed a bug where the top of the burger didn't want to cover the finished burger
- Fixed a bug where the last piece of pizza remained raw
- Fixed a bug that caused users to stop leaving trash behind
- Fixed bug with incorrect display of date and time on saves
- Fixed a bug with a memory leak after customizing an outlet



[b]Minor edits:[/b]
- The city system was rebuilt. Some buildings have been replaced. Changed non-key building locations
- Reducing the number of calls to draw the camera to improve fps stability
- Removed old timekeeping system
- Redesigned localization system
- Added a notification when trying to open a store without items on sale
- Fixed UI error for water, milk and coffee when adding them to the coffee machine
- Slightly changed the mechanics of burger buns
- Now the game settings menu returns to the top position every time you open it
- Fixed glitch re-entering the settings menu, buttons were not pressed.
- The upper fps limit is limited for the stable operation of the application and the reduction of the number of crashes
- Removed old skyboxes that cut performance on low-end PCs
- Changed skyboxes morning/afternoon/evening/night
- Cooked pizza can no longer be frozen

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
Changes in mechanics:
- The game no longer ends when the last task is completed. Now you can do it manually in the task menu
- Added community items: cards, backgrounds, icons

Bugs fixed:
- Fixed bug with city map opening
- Fixed a bug with ordering goods that cannot be sold at points
- Minor bugs fixed

Minor edits:
- Code optimization
- Changed mustard jar color (again)

notes.title: Update
notes.content:

- Added translations to: French, Spanish, Portuguese, Polish, Turkish, Indonesian
- Added 52 new customers
- Added a hint about the content inside the finished product
- Employees give a list of missing products in the upper right corner of the screen
- Knives are no longer duplicated
- Knives return to the knife stand after loading save
- Reduced cost of stands for hot dogs and kebabs

[b]Bugs fixed:[/b]
- Fixed anchor issues after saving for the following objects: coffee cup, hot dog bun, sausages, hot dog, kebab, beer glass, deep-frying basket, cutlet, pizza
- Fixed bug of positions in the press grill after cooking kebab 
- Fixed bug of positions in hot dog holder
- Fixed bug with sauces remaining in hand during inventory mode: take a few
- Fixed interface bugs 
- Fixed character control when using non-standard buttons
- Fixed the bug of not fully used goods such as: water, milk, coffee
- Fixed interface bug after using refrigerator 
- Fixed a bug with customers who picked up a burger without a cutlet
- Fixed bug with opening a nightclub after downloading
- Bug fixed by product quality assessment for cutlets

[b]Minor edits:[/b]
- Added soft light
- Fixed translation errors
- Scripts optimization
- The text interface is no longer updated every second
- Reduced number of Draw Calls
- Minor edits to the UI interface 
- Lots of minor edits

Special thanks to [b]Anush[/b] for help with 3D models of citizens

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
Changes in mechanics:
- The merchant checks the availability of equipment at the point. Now he can not sell products for the preparation of which the missing equipment is necessary
- Merchant says what ingredient is missing for cooking
- Refrigerator: now you can add water and a box of beer
- Added message for draught beer stand that there is not enough glass, keg, CO2 tank
- Removed small shelves inside the points of sale 
- Added a large shelf to the C&T store
- Added a stand for ready-made hot dogs. Can also be used for ready-made kebabs

Bugs fixed:
- Refrigerator: now cools the goods that are in it
- Refrigerator: no longer rolls over
- Refrigerator: fixed bug with saving goods inside
- Fixed a bug prohibiting lifting pizza that fell to the floor or its pieces on the last point
- Fixed a bug that did not count the installation of all types of equipment for pizzeria
- Fixed bug with merchants
- Fixed a bug with the last piece of pizza that could not be given to the client
- Fixed a bug in the amount of dark beer when transferring to a merchant
- Fixed bug of the number of french fries when transferring to the merchant
- Fixed crash from the game after removing equipment

Minor edits
- Added additional video tutorials
- Fixed description of the amount of dark beer in the list of products of the merchant
- Increased equipment inspection radius for the last point
- Some minor changes

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:

- Fixed bug with changing the quality and size of the screen on the first launch
- Fixed a bug changing the translation into Russian at the first launch
- Fixed bug with management at first launch

- Fixed translation errors
- The position of the CO2 cylinder in the Techno Boom store has been changed
- Reduce collider for cans of soda and can of beer

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Bugs fixed in this patch: 
- Solved bugs with baskets
- There was no message about insufficient money
- Fixed the mechanism of the quest from the 3rd stage of the game
- Fixed too loud laughter next to the pharmacy
- The problem of storage for french fries has been fixed. Now the vault can be cleaned by looking at the potatoes and pressing the "X" key
- Fixed product bugs from product store when you press the right mouse
- Fixed customization bug at third point
- Hanging people are removed every morning
- Fixed bug with another trader at the point
- Fixed the sauce removal bug through the trash can
- Fixed some sound bugs
- Fixed bug hovering orders at open menu

Changes in this patch: 
- The game has been transferred to a new version of the engine
- New sounds added
- Added a map of the city on the "M" key
- Changed product names in purchase mode
- The opportunity to buy next-level equipment ahead of time has been removed

- New furniture added to Store C&T

- The position of the finished meat has been corrected
- Lots of small edits
